pack-land: A small wooden box set down on mossy ground: a soft earthy thud with a leafy rustle. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
pack-hover: A short crisp rustle of a dry leaf rubbed between fingers, clearly audible. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
tear-scrub: Continuous slow peeling of fibrous bark and dry leaves torn by hand, crackly woody rip, steady and loopable. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
tear: A quick tear through a wrapping of large dry leaves and twine, a crisp fibrous rip ending with a small twig snap. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
pack-burst: A gust of forest wind scattering leaves in a soft swirling rush, then a few gentle wooden kalimba notes, an earthy magical reveal.
cards-slide: Smooth wooden tiles sliding across a mossy log, soft woody glide ending in a gentle stop. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
deal: A single thin wooden card placed down quickly on a wooden table, a short soft woody click. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
flip: A single large leaf flipped over quickly, a short soft leafy flick. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
uncommon: A single water droplet falling into a still pond, a clear round bloop with a soft ripple.
rare: Three warm rising kalimba notes with a soft breathy wooden flute tone, a pleasant forest discovery.
mythic: A gentle forest awakening: a soft rising wooden flute melody over warm kalimba arpeggios, rustling leaves and a light sparkle, calm and wondrous, not loud. No drums.
select: A single short crisp snap of a small dry twig, clearly audible. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
deselect: A softer, lower, duller bamboo tock, muted and short. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
pick: A wooden card slid into a woven basket: a soft reedy rustle and a satisfying hollow wooden thunk. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
burn: Dry leaves tossed into a campfire: a quick crackling flare and a soft whoosh, short.
pack-arrive: A small wooden box pushed across a mossy table, a soft woody slide stopping with a light bump. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
pack-pass: A small wooden box pushed away across a wooden table, a short soft woody slide. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
tick: A single loud sharp knock on a hollow wooden log, like a wooden clock tick: bright, clear and hollow with a short ringing decay. Close-up, dry, no music.
tap: A wooden card turned sideways on a wooden table, a soft woody scrape and tap. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
zoom-open: A soft rising breeze through leaves, a short gentle airy rustle swelling up. Close-up, no music, no voices.
zoom-close: A soft breeze settling, a gentle leafy rustle fading down, short. Close-up, no music, no voices.
row-hover: An extremely quiet tiny twig tick, barely audible and very short. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
turn-over: A large leaf twirled over in the hand: a soft leafy flutter and a light flick. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
